payload.rebuttal: argued: The probe makes the documented-node loop walk every statement of an ast.Module instead of only body[0], blanking each bare string constant it finds. Under this mutated code the note would still never be flagged by the prose gate, just for a different reason: instead of never being seen as a node, it would now be blanked out as a pseudo-docstring. Either way the fact this spec's test exists to cover holds: the production prose gate misses the note's word count. No test inside tests/test_probe_check.py can tell these two internal reasons apart without asserting on prose.py's private node-walk, which would mean editing a forbidden, protected file, or reimplementing the general bare-statement sentence check the spec's own Out of scope section assigns to a later spec. The spec's Problem section says this test stands in for the gate by hand because the gate cannot check the note at all; it does not ask the test to explain why the gate misses it. I made no change.
